text: Add a reading default: every acceptance criterion must check the requested behavior happening, not just that types, files or wiring exist. Any test of a protection or denial must first show the action succeeds without the protection, under the same user and environment the real component runs as (here, root), and then show it is refused. If the environment cannot enforce the protection, the test must fail, not skip or pass silently. Show that a reading for a 'make X read-only' or 'role calls a model' request produces criteria of this form.
